## Scope

What user or contributor problem does this change address?

## Evidence and verification

- [ ] Relevant tests/checks run (list them and summarize results).
- [ ] Evidence type is clear: fixture/mock, offline, live provider, or platform.
- [ ] If checks were not run, explain why.

## Documentation

- [ ] User/contributor documentation updated, or not applicable (explain).

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, private source, personal data, or sensitive logs included.
- [ ] Considered command execution, file writes, and data sent to providers.
- [ ] No uncoordinated disclosure of suspected vulnerabilities; report those privately first.
- [ ] File-write changes preserve isolation and checkpoint/rollback compatibility, or explain the impact.
